items.title: Harvest a Firecracker Berry
items.detail: Fast travel to Arktos Pharma; harvest quickly before plants explode

items.title: Collect Brain Fungus
items.detail: Found in dark caves like Wendigo Cave, Kerwood Mine, or Abandoned Waste Dump

items.title: Collect Deathclaw Eggs
items.detail: Check nests outside Abandoned Waste Dump in The Mire; server hop if needed

items.title: Complete the Event: Mischief Night
items.detail: Public event at Rapidan Camp on the hour; light the pyre and follow the Eyebot

items.title: Cook Brain Fungus Soup
items.detail: Collect Brain Fungus, then cook at a Cooking Station with Boiled Water and Wood

items.title: Kill a Lost during the Mischief Night Event
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night and kill Lost Dwellers during the event

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find active Infestation on map (gray cloudy area) and eliminate Phantoms in the hotspot

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Enter build menu and construct basic wood or concrete floors, then scrap them

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Clear a full Infestation event from start to boss defeat for rare 4-Star legendary loot

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; yield varies by fish size

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for reliable spawns; use energy weapons

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume pre-war items like BlamCo Mac and Cheese or Fancy Lads Snack Cakes

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond; target the eyes as weak spot using V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event, then stay in Vertibot area for Phantom spawn

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter and submit to Discord for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal public event at Rapidan Camp with exclusive rewards and masked cultist encounters.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Bonus mutation chance during Daily Ops with new seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring spooky Scorched enemies with new rewards and themed encounters.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Experience points gained are doubled for faster leveling and Scoreboard progression.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event.
